svg.text: 1. ONE STAND FOR EVERYTHING WITH A CLEAR MOUNT BOSS: BOTH PAY CASES AND THE TABLET SHELLS. TWIST 35° TO LOCK.
2. FIXED 15° TOWARD THE CUSTOMER. FOR STAFF-FACING TABLETS USE THE SWIVEL STAND, CLR-HW-301.
3. STEEL PLATE 100 × 90 × 5 IN THE BASE. CABLE LEAVES THROUGH THE BACK OF THE BASE.
4. SOCKET CENTRE 159 MM UP: A CHIP CARD CLEARS THE COUNTER UNDER EITHER CASE.
